notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/51c916d14fd841800ad0c5d536495c0db5e179fe.gif"][/img][/p][p]Patch 1.1 is here, bringing full controller support, a range of accessibility features, and various improvements to UI and quality of life across the board![/p][p][/p][p]We're also excited to announce that...[/p][p][/p][h2][i]of the Devil[/i] is coming to PLAY NYC @ ANIME NYC! Visual variety of text encountered will be greatly reduced.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added an option to switch to Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia color modes.[/p][list][*][p]Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->Color Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Algorithmically adjusts the colors used in key UI elements to improve readability for those with the setting's listed type of color-blindness.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added an option to double the duration given for time-sensitive gameplay sections or remove time-limits entirely.[/p][list][*][p]Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->Time-Sensitive Choices.[/p][/*][*][p]Affects the time between witness statements in Objection gameplay. If time-limits are removed, witness statements will no longer proceed automatically during Objection gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Affects the time allowed for choosing a card after CALL-ing on a witness statement during Objection gameplay. If time-limits are removed, no duration indicators will appear.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added an option to minimize non-essential camera motion.[/p][list][*][p]Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->Camera Motion.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevents small, looping animations from affecting cameras.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevents the camera from being shaken.[/p][/*][*][p]Skips over fast-motion-blurred camera-swivel animations inside the courtroom.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added an option to minimize high-pitch "ringing" looped sound effects.[/p][list][*][p]Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->High Pitch Ambient SFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Mutes a number of looped sound effects. Auditory ambience will be impacted.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added an option to minimize "glitching" visual effects in Accessibility->"Glitch" VFX.[/p][list][*][p]Dropdown found in Settings->Accessibility->"Glitch" VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Disables a variety of "Glitch" post-processing effects. Visual variety will be impacted.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added an option to "lock" displayed controls to a specific type of controller.[/p][list][*][p]Dropdown found in Settings->Gameplay->Displayed Controls.[/p][/*][*][p]If of the Devil will always display the controls for the selected device regardless of what other device you make inputs with if "Displayed Controls" is not set to "Automatic."[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/f452d2f95736f3964a3d230c5e45f7c8a3787276.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Note that none of the accessibility options listed above are overridden by enabling Highroller mode.[/b][/p][p]As a reminder, Highroller affects the following:[/p][list][*][p]Players are limited to one save slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Players cannot load saves from the phone menu during courtroom gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Players cannot quick-save.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-saves will not occur.[/p][/*][*][p]Maximum Ante will be higher in every section Ante segments.[/p][list][*][p]Hovering the mouse over or selecting the CALL button with gamepad will now highlight certain words in a witness' statement in red.[/p][/*][*][p]These words are intended to Insight.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added the ability to return the last card placed on the timeline to hand using "Return" input during Timeline gameplay (Right-Mouse click by default).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/3197e3aa15134e40ed17ab352cc26467508c55fe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img [/p][p]As always, you can report bugs or request assistance from us on [url="https://discord.gg/UVdtGDMWMg"]our official Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to Wishlist Episode 2, coming soon![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3124590/of_the_Devil__Episode_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: Added controller recognition and support for DualShock, Xbox, Steam Deck, Switch and Generic gamepads for all gameplay.
Added support for playing the game with WASD/Arrow Keys and Keyboard rather than Mouse and Keyboard.
Added glyphs in the bottom-right corner that display controls for the most recently used device (e.g. Dualshock).
Added glyphs to various UI elements that display context-sensitive controls for the most recently used device (e.g. Delete selected save slot).
Controls for zooming in and moving unlocked images in the concept gallery have been re-worked across the board (Players no longer need to right click to drag).
Controls for Investigating environments have been re-worked across the board (Mouse or reticle movement close to the center of the screen will not prompt the camera to move).
Added an option to switch to Dyslexic and low-vision friendly fonts
Added an option to switch to Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia color modes.
Added an option to double the duration given for time-sensitive gameplay sections or remove time-limits entirely.
Added an option to minimize non-essential camera motion.
Added an option to minimize high-pitch "ringing" looped sound effects.
Added an option to minimize "glitching" visual effects in Accessibility->"Glitch" VFX.
Added an option to "lock" displayed controls to a specific type of controller.
Added an [b]Insight[/b] mechanic to Objection segments.
Added the ability to return the last card placed on the timeline to hand using "Return" input during Timeline gameplay (Right-Mouse click by default).
Adjusted UI visuals for various menus to better provide feedback of when an item is selected, "pressed" or de-selected with either mouse or gamepad.
Adjusted the dialogue text box to leave room in bottom right corner for control glyphs.
Adjusted visuals for Timeline gameplay.
Collected Profiles, Articles, Terms and Evidence will now be automatically sorted in phone menus..
Added a button for returning to Title Screen to the phone's "Main Menu."

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where certain specific UI elements were not scaling properly at ultra-wide resolutions.
Fixed an issue where opacity of the Phone UI was not always responding correctly to adjusted settings.
Fixed an issue where saves made at certain parts of courtroom sections could record data improperly.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the layering of the Ante UI so Card details no longer can be obscured by Ante meter/fire visuals.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/98073d6c24a1fa97213a3dd0fcee24491c921ded.gif[/img]

Patch 1.05 is here! In addition to a handful of fixes, corrections, and quality of life features, we’re excited to announce that we’ve also made additions that should improve performance and optimization across a variety of player setups!

If you’re curious about what’s new in Patch 1.05:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/22961467b411ec0ea8d2ed1672d259c7aff510e3.png[/img]

of the Devil no longer restricts the list of resolutions you can choose from- you’re free to select any resolution that your monitor supports. Please note that choosing [b]a resolution listed in red is not recommended as it may result in small presentation issues.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/d4c15775b2c5f4e355e035cebf2a24f8db5ecd3f.png[/img]

of the Devil has a new feature in the Settings menu that allows you to select a Frames-per-Second number to target. If you’re playing on an older computer, running on a battery, or just more interested in fidelity than framerate, you can set it to 30 FPS for longer battery life (and more quiet PC fans) or even as low as 24 FPS for a more “cinematic” feel.

You can also set the FPS target to try and always match your monitor’s refresh rate, or you can choose to play with your framerate entirely uncapped, but these options are recommended only for higher spec machines.


[h3]Optimization and Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Significantly reduced memory usage on start up, reducing the time it takes for the game to boot up.
[*] Significantly reduced the average and maximum memory usage in-game, reducing the risk of crashes and improving performance on computers with less available RAM.
[*] Added a Target FPS dropdown to settings and set of the Devil’s default target FPS to no greater than 60.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where certain choice cards and evidence items weren’t matching their display names 1:1.
[*] Adjusted minor contextual hinting during Trial 1-1.

[/list]

[h3]Scripting:[/h3]
[list]

[/list]

[h3]UI and Display:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the incorrect resolution value could be displayed upon starting the game and opening Settings for the first time.
[*] Fixed an issue where text reveal speed set in Settings was resetting to default value at improper times.
[*] Fixed an issue where Wager choices could fail to scale up properly if the game was being Skipped through at a high enough speed.
[*] Fixed an issue where screen elements in the background of the Courtroom could fail to animate properly.
[*] Reduced the intensity of camera bobbing inside the Courtroom.
[*] Fixed an issue where charms’ reflections were being lit improperly based on certain backgrounds being loaded.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Dialogue textbox would display text improperly for the duration of its dismissal animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain choice cards could be dragged and dropped at inappropriate times.
[*] Fixed an issue where Dialogue could display instantly due to certain player input in Objection segments.
[*] Fixed an issue where Investigation camera movement wouldn’t always freeze while the game is paused.
[*] Fixed an issue where Settings wouldn’t display the proper values on the in-game phone if adjusted from the title screen or vice-versa.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain UI elements and unlockable concept art would appear at the wrong resolution on certain graphics quality settings.
[*] Fixed an issue where the phone wouldn’t always have the proper case color during texting conversations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the backlog could be viewed on the title screen.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements and Quality of Life features we're looking into for future patches:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Additional keyboard shortcuts for navigating to Evidence, Profiles, Settings, etc.
[*] More robust support for Steam Deck and other controller setups.
[/list]

notes.title: "Wager" Mechanic Preview
notes.content:
[h1]Don't take the bait.[/h1]

[previewyoutube=x0dfzkNDd4c;full][/previewyoutube]

Read your opponent's confidence and bet accordingly! 

Our brand-new "Wager" gameplay mechanic is a test of your confidence and your ability to read that of the opposition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/09be197321a8986b87410237be8ea231a7fb2d8f.png[/img]

If you think your opponent's got an answer, "Stay" to avoid overcommitting. You'll still take some damage when they reveal their facts and shift the argument in their favor, but you'll have minimized your losses and kept them from taking back all the momentum. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/a419de7ca02968505958225e708f1dbfe09e3bca.png[/img]

If you think they're bluffing or you notice that they're just dead wrong, "Raise" and press them where it hurts the most!

notes.title: "Credit" Mechanic Overview
notes.content:
[h1]The Devil's in the Details.[/h1]

[previewyoutube=x0dfzkNDd4c;full][/previewyoutube]

We've developed a robust "Credit" system where exploration and intelligent questioning is rewarded. 
Every time you examine part of the environment or find a new clue, your credit will increase. You can then use what you've learned to ask smarter questions which reward you with even more Credit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/31220b78629c7876b702ed2a33f9fa44705f1b59.png[/img]

Answer questions incorrectly or fail at a puzzle and your Credit will decrease. If you lose all credibility, characters will have no reason to listen to your arguments anymore and you'll get fired or worse; That's Game Over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/0ce3697d1c647f162db61be067679e22bf5a9fe2.png[/img]

When the case is solved, you can spend the Credit you earned in your playthrough on bonuses like additional playable scenarios and concept art.

Check every corner and read every article to build up your Credit- then use the info you've gathered to unlock additional questions and dialogue options!

notes.title: "Hand" Gameplay Preview
notes.content:
[h1]How Good's Your Pokerface?[/h1]

[previewyoutube=opvW0vcHidM;full][/previewyoutube]

In our brand-new "Hand" style of gameplay, you'll need to read the flow of the argument and follow your opponent's logic. Then, when it's your chance to strike back, choose from amongst all the evidence, facts, and testimony you've gathered the perfect card to slam down and upend the opposition's play. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/3f69df1ef515a669e7b52fd78ac2e48ce50adc52.png[/img]

Win the "Hand" and the case will continue, and you'll get to reap double the credit you were forced to wager. Lose too many hands and you'll eventually completely run out of credit- which means Game Over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44837048/804a5e1a7d4317ad282122a0a3b67846a7e1a691.png[/img]

So try your best to read the cards.
